turns.message: 2024年账单国为美国的发票销售额同比增长率是多少？
turns.sql: SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN invoice_date >= '2024-01-01' AND invoice_date < '2025-01-01' THEN total ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN invoice_date >= '2023-01-01' AND invoice_date < '2024-01-01' THEN total ELSE 0 END)) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN invoice_date >= '2023-01-01' AND invoice_date < '2024-01-01' THEN total ELSE 0 END), 0) AS yoy_growth_rate FROM public.invoice WHERE billing_country = 'USA'

SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN "invoice_date" >= '2024-01-01' AND "invoice_date" < '2025-01-01' THEN "total" ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN "invoice_date" >= '2023-01-01' AND "invoice_date" < '2024-01-01' THEN "total" ELSE 0 END)) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN "invoice_date" >= '2023-01-01' AND "invoice_date" < '2024-01-01' THEN "total" ELSE 0 END), 0) AS yoy_growth_rate FROM "public"."invoice" WHERE "billing_country" = 'Canada'

SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN i.invoice_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND i.invoice_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) THEN i.total ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN i.invoice_date >= CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE) AND i.invoice_date < CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) THEN i.total ELSE 0 END)) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN i.invoice_date >= CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE) AND i.invoice_date < CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) THEN i.total ELSE 0 END), 0) AS yoy_growth_rate FROM "public"."invoice" AS i WHERE i.billing_country = 'Canada'

turns.message: 指标换成平均每张发票金额。
turns.sql: SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN "invoice_date" >= '2025-01-01' AND "invoice_date" < '2026-01-01' THEN "total" END) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN "invoice_date" >= '2025-01-01' AND "invoice_date" < '2026-01-01' THEN 1 END), 0)) / NULLIF((SUM(CASE WHEN "invoice_date" >= '2024-01-01' AND "invoice_date" < '2025-01-01' THEN "total" END) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN "invoice_date" >= '2024-01-01' AND "invoice_date" < '2025-01-01' THEN 1 END), 0)), 0) - 1 AS yoy_growth_rate FROM "public"."invoice" WHERE "billing_country" = 'Canada'

WITH agg AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', "invoice_date") AS yr, AVG("total") AS avg_amt, COUNT("invoice_id") AS cnt FROM "public"."invoice" WHERE "billing_country" = 'Germany' AND "invoice_date" >= '2024-01-01' AND "invoice_date" < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', "invoice_date")) SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN yr = '2025-01-01' THEN avg_amt ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN yr = '2024-01-01' THEN avg_amt ELSE 0 END), 0)) - 1 AS yoy_growth_rate FROM agg

SELECT (cur.avg_amount - bas.avg_amount) / NULLIF(bas.avg_amount, 0) AS yoy_growth_rate FROM (SELECT AVG(i.total) AS avg_amount FROM "public"."invoice" AS i WHERE i.invoice_date >= CAST('2023-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP) AND i.invoice_date < CAST('2024-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP) AND i.billing_country = 'Germany') AS cur CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(i.total) AS avg_amount FROM "public"."invoice" AS i WHERE i.invoice_date >= CAST('2022-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP) AND i.invoice_date < CAST('2023-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP) AND i.billing_country = 'Germany') AS bas LIMIT 200
